method.baseline: Neutral IDLE game-runtime throughput, not learned-model throughput
method.counter_source: Differences of returned cumulative physics_ticks and simulated_seconds; no assumed ticks per decision
method.end_to_end_rate: Executed decisions / episode wall seconds including shutdown and failed calls
method.episode_wall_seconds: Environment construction through close, including Python recording/validation overhead
method.failure_policy: Record early terminals/errors and stop; no dropped episodes or replacement seeds
method.latency_p95: Linear interpolation at rank 0.95 * (N - 1) of sorted successful step-call durations
method.reset_inclusive_rate: Executed decisions / (reset wall seconds + successful step-call wall seconds)
method.startup: One env.reset call per episode; launches a fresh isolated worker and generates/settles its world
method.step_wall_seconds: Sum of individual synchronous env.step call durations, including transport and observation encoding
method.warmup: Optional separate first-train-seed episode, excluded from every aggregate
method.weighted_rates: Sum of executed counters / sum of measured durations; never mean of per-episode rates

settings.selection: first N entries in manifest order
